图片内文字：
- Medical Affairs – Clinical trials (IIS/ECR/ONIS)
- Planning Phase: pre merger clearance
  - Identify all ongoing local clinical trials (IIS/ECR/ONIS) -> refer to transfer status in Appendix (next slides)
  - Continue executing on ongoing studies according to Boehringer SOPs and process with same level of urgency
  - Prepare for transfer all materials and data related to the clinical trial (IIS/ECR/ONIS) that will be transferred (Appendix 1)
  - Plan for onboarding sessions on studies (IIS/ECR/ONIS) to LEO’s personnel
  - Prepare for publication obligation of these studies/data that are not reflected in the publication plan
  - Align with LEO on which studies (IIS/ECR/ONIS) they wish to take over and are not reflected in the OTA eg 1368-0182
  - Prepare for closing and ensure archiving, cancelling and termination all other studies
  - Develop a local exit strategy and communication of EAT program incl out-of-scope based on global guidance
- Preparation Phase: post merger clearance
  - Start onboarding sessions on studies (IIS/ECR/ONIS) to LEO’s personnel
  - Align with LEO on which studies (IIS/ECR/ONIS) they wish to take over and are not reflected in the OTA
- Execution: post effective date
  - Transfer agreed studies and related materials/documents (IIS/ECR/ONIS) to LEO
  - Discontinue/terminate studies (IIS/ECR/ONIS) which will not transition to LEO (service end date, 31 Dec 2025)
  - Stop or transition local trials including OOS/EAP
  - Invite LEO’s personnel to already planned external meetings as relevant to support the transition (service end date, 31 Dec 2025)
  - Conduct meetings between relevant medical teams of Boehringer and LEO to facilitate the transfer of knowledge (service end date, 31 Dec 2025)
- Boehringer Ingelheim
- *NOTE: Clinical trials and Post Marketing Studies (PMS/PhIV) to be found in “CLINICAL TRIALS” section
- Privileged and Confidential For internal use only
- 69

视觉关系：
- 页面为三列阶段式流程/roadmap结构，从左到右依次为：
  1) Planning Phase（pre merger clearance）
  2) Preparation Phase（post merger clearance）
  3) Execution（post effective date）
- 每一列下方以项目符号列出该阶段对应的任务清单；右侧“Execution”列中的多条任务包含同一关键时间点“service end date, 31 Dec 2025”，用于标记停止/终止/支持过渡/知识转移相关动作的截止时间。
